battlecraft.custom.preset.outward.hint: Edge pulls the frame from outside
battlecraft.custom.glass.surfaceAlpha.hi: Overall opacity of every panel. Below one the sharp frame starts showing through, not only the blurred snapshot.
battlecraft.custom.glass.density.hint: How much dark body is laid over the blurred backdrop. Zero is pure refraction with no film.
battlecraft.custom.glass.brightness.hint: Brightness of what shows through the panel. Below one darkens the backdrop without touching the glass body.
battlecraft.custom.glass.lift.hint: How strongly hover and press light up the glass body.
battlecraft.custom.glass.edge.hint: Contour feather in screen pixels. Larger means a softer panel edge.
battlecraft.custom.glass.border.hint: Clear margin along the edge: body and refraction step inward by this width.
battlecraft.custom.glass.softness.hint: Band over which the effect reaches full strength. Removes the visible step between panel and backdrop. Liquid glass only.
battlecraft.custom.glass.dissolve.hint: Width of the skirt that dissolves the edge into the backdrop instead of cutting it off.
battlecraft.custom.glass.dissolveChaos.h: Skirt roughness. Zero is an even ring, higher is a ragged edge.
battlecraft.custom.glass.dissolveDrift.h: How fast the ragged edge stirs.
battlecraft.custom.glass.squircle.hint: Corner exponent. Two is a true circle, higher is a squircle.
Corner shape of the toggle track and knob. Kept apart from panels.
battlecraft.custom.glass.radiusPanel.hin: Corner radius of large panels and windows.
battlecraft.custom.glass.radiusCell.hint: Corner radius of small cells: buttons, tiles, bars.
battlecraft.custom.glass.hudScale.hint: Size of the whole HUD. Menu screens are not affected.
battlecraft.custom.glass.band.hint: Width of the strip along the edge where the glass refracts. This is the visible edge width, not the strength.
battlecraft.custom.glass.pull.hint: Index of refraction. This is the knob for distortion strength.
battlecraft.custom.glass.switchLens.hint: Share of the overall refraction strength used by the toggle knob: one matches the panels, higher bends more, zero is a flat knob.
battlecraft.custom.glass.falloff.hint: How deep into the strip the bend survives. Lower keeps the bend further from the edge.
battlecraft.custom.glass.bendAim.hint: Which way light bends at the edge. Negative pulls the sample inward, positive pushes it outward so the edge drags in the frame from beyond the window. Zero kills refraction.
battlecraft.custom.glass.bendReach.hint: How far the sample travels, in edge thicknesses. Larger squeezes more of the frame into the edge.
battlecraft.custom.glass.zoom.hint: Slight pull of the backdrop toward the panel centre.
battlecraft.custom.glass.rings.hint: How many rings the panel is split into on the ring path. More is a smoother gradient and a costlier frame. Works without liquid glass only.
battlecraft.custom.glass.edgeRings.hint: How many of those rings fall on the edge. Works without liquid glass only.
battlecraft.custom.glass.dispersion.hint: Red and blue splitting at the edge: the rainbow rim of real glass.
battlecraft.custom.glass.saturation.hint: Saturation of the backdrop under the panel. Above one pulls colour out instead of laying a dark film. Liquid glass only.
battlecraft.custom.glass.blurShrink.hint: How much the snapshot shrinks before blurring. One is full resolution and a pixel perfect backdrop.
battlecraft.custom.glass.blurLevels.hint: Steps of the blur pyramid. Radius comes from steps, not from kernel width.
battlecraft.custom.glass.blurDown.hint: Kernel on the way down the pyramid. Above two texels a grid of replicas appears.
battlecraft.custom.glass.blurUp.hint: Kernel on the way up the pyramid.
battlecraft.custom.glass.blurPolish.hint: Final pass over the finished blur. Zero drops the pass entirely.
battlecraft.custom.glass.fresnelRange.hi: Width of the fresnel rim along the panel edge. Liquid glass only.
battlecraft.custom.glass.fresnelHard.hin: Sharpness of the rim transition. Liquid glass only.
battlecraft.custom.glass.fresnelGlow.hin: Rim brightness. Zero removes it. Liquid glass only.
battlecraft.custom.glass.sweepDepth.hint: Depth of the sweeping highlight on buttons.
battlecraft.custom.glass.sweepLight.hint: Brightness of the sweeping highlight. Zero turns it off.
battlecraft.custom.glass.sweepPower.hint: Sharpness of the highlight: higher is a narrower band.
battlecraft.custom.glass.sweepPeriod.hin: Milliseconds for one pass of the highlight.
battlecraft.custom.glass.glowSpread.hint: Spread of the halo around letters. Text has no shadow, the halo takes the colour of the letter itself.
battlecraft.custom.glass.glowAlpha.hint: Density of the halo around letters.
battlecraft.custom.glass.glowLift.hint: How much white is mixed into the halo.
battlecraft.custom.glass.textWeight.hint: How heavy the letter strokes are. Left is thinner, right is bolder.
battlecraft.custom.color.accent.hint: Main colour of active elements and text. Editing it stops following the launcher theme.
battlecraft.custom.color.textDim.hint: Colour of secondary text: values and captions.
battlecraft.custom.color.textFaint.hint: Colour of the faintest text: hints and inactive rows.
battlecraft.custom.color.alert.hint: Alert colour: deletion, refusals, critical values.
battlecraft.custom.color.backdrop.hint: Colour of the menu ground under the aurora.
battlecraft.custom.color.panel.hint: Colour of plates that do not go through the glass.
battlecraft.custom.color.glass.hint: Colour of the glass body. Separate from the accent: it paints the panel itself.
battlecraft.custom.color.wellTop.hint: Top of the well: sunken backings of tracks, empty slots and input fields.
battlecraft.custom.color.wellBottom.hint: Bottom of the well: sunken backings of tracks, empty slots and input fields.
battlecraft.custom.color.stroke.hint: Colour of the stroke on elements that draw one.
battlecraft.custom.color.zoneFriendly.hi: Colour of your own team zone in the world and on the map.
battlecraft.custom.color.zoneHostile.hin: Colour of an enemy zone in the world and on the map.
battlecraft.custom.color.zoneShop.hint: Colour of a shop zone in the world and on the map.
battlecraft.custom.color.zoneContested.h: Colour of a zone under capture in the world and on the map.
battlecraft.custom.color.damage.hint: Colour of regular damage numbers. Follows the accent until you pick one.
battlecraft.custom.color.damageCrit.hint: Colour of critical and headshot numbers. Follows the accent until you pick one.
battlecraft.custom.font.hint: Interface typeface: crisp, soft or bitmap.
battlecraft.custom.sound.hint: Interface sound set. A sample plays as you pick.
battlecraft.custom.sound_volume.hint: Volume of interface sounds. Game volume is not affected.
battlecraft.custom.motion.hint: How windows arrive and leave: the whole motion set.
battlecraft.custom.discord.hint: Show the current game in your Discord status.
battlecraft.custom.heartbeat.hint: HUD elements pulse with your heartbeat: the lower the health, the faster.
battlecraft.custom.island.hint: Plate in the top left corner with profile, music and readouts.
battlecraft.custom.island_media.hint: Take the playing track from the Windows system player.
battlecraft.custom.island.visualizer.hin: The bars follow the real sound spectrum, not an animation.
battlecraft.custom.island.cover_tint.hin: Colour the bars with the leading colour of the track cover. Switched off, they return to the accent.
battlecraft.custom.radio_hud.hint: Who is on the air, how long they have been talking and how their recording runs.
battlecraft.custom.voice_trace.hint: A running recording next to the microphone badge while you talk.
battlecraft.custom.radio_static.hint: Radio voice goes through a radio path: narrow band, clipping and distance interference.
battlecraft.custom.radio_chirp.hint: The radio clicks on its own: keying up and releasing, the start and end of someone else's transmission, powering on and off.
battlecraft.custom.radio_key.hint: Transmit with the walkie-talkie on your belt: hold the key, no need to take it in hand. A walkie-talkie in hand transmits as before.
battlecraft.custom.radio_noise.hint: How much noise and dropout distance adds. Zero leaves only the radio path.
battlecraft.custom.visualizer_gain.hint: Sensitivity multiplier of the bars to loudness.
battlecraft.custom.visualizer_speed.hint: How fast the bars catch up with the sound.
battlecraft.custom.visualizer_light.hint: How light the colours taken from the cover come out. Below a hundred per cent the dark parts of the cover show more.
battlecraft.custom.visualizer_attack.hin: How fast a bar climbs to a louder level. At two hundred per cent the climb takes half as long as on the iPhone.
battlecraft.custom.island_flip.hint: How fast the cover turns over when the track changes.
battlecraft.custom.visualizer_color.hint: How deep the colours taken from the cover come out. At a hundred per cent the bars stay closest to the cover itself.
battlecraft.custom.liquid.hint: Shader glass instead of the ring path. Turning it off restores the old path where some knobs do nothing.
battlecraft.custom.glass_theme.hint: Paint the glass body with the launcher theme colour.
battlecraft.custom.follow_launcher.hint: Take the accent from the launcher theme. Any manual colour edit stops following it.
battlecraft.custom.accent_ink.hint: Colour every piece of interface text in the accent: the main, dimmed and faint inks all take its hue. Manual text colours on this tab win over it.
battlecraft.custom.hud_accent.hint: Colour every piece of HUD text in the accent, leaving menus and screens on the plain ink. It wins over the manual text colours on this tab, and a slot tint set in the HUD editor wins over it.
battlecraft.custom.hud.slot.hint: Show the element on screen. Moving and resizing happens in the live game with the chat open.
